text: Neither the LinkedIn posting nor the sibling Citi careers posting (same job family, SVP grade, Irving TX) names a manager or carries a reports-to line. Both place the role inside Citi's AI Transformation effort (job family group: Technology; job family: Applications Development) and reference Citi's agent ecosystem. One web search surfaced adjacent leadership reqs (Head of Applied AI and Agent Factory, MD; Head of AI-First Development, MD) and reporting that Citi is consolidating AI under a single Group Head of AI, but no posting ties this Director req to a named person. No name is recorded on purpose.
source: JD: https://www.linkedin.com/jobs/view/4450095632/ ; sibling posting: https://jobs.citi.com/job/irving/forward-deployed-engineer-ai-transformation-senior-vice-president/287/98836095264 ; one WebSearch (2026-09-04): 'Citi "AI Transformation" head leadership forward deployed engineer 2026'
